channel.title: Crypto Docket
channel.description: Crypto Docket reports news across crypto: Bitcoin and Ethereum, layer-2 networks, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation and security incidents.

item.title: US secures court authority over $1.2bn in Binance theft
item.description: US authorities have court authority to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion in stolen Binance crypto, within a wider freeze exceeding $2.7 billion.

item.title: US secures authority to seize or restrain $1.2bn in Binance theft
item.description: US authorities won court approval to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion of stolen Binance crypto, while efforts to freeze and recover the rest continue.

item.title: US wins court authority over $1.2bn in Binance hack funds
item.description: The Justice Department has court approval to seize or restrain over $1.2 billion of Binance hack proceeds, part of $2.7 billion frozen as tracing continues.

item.title: US courts authorize seizure of $1.2bn in Binance hack
item.description: The Justice Department says courts have authorized seizure or restraint of more than $1.2 billion from Binance’s $6.3 billion hack, while tracing continues.

item.title: US Secures Court Authority Over $1.2B in Binance Hack Crypto
item.description: US authorities secured court approval to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion in Binance hack proceeds; recovery now depends on tracing and forfeiture.

item.title: Deutsche Bank launches crypto custody for European institutions
item.description: Deutsche Bank has opened crypto custody to European institutions and agreed to explore tokenized products with Deutsche Asset Management, moving from plan to service.

item.title: Deutsche Bank opens crypto custody to paying clients
item.description: Deutsche Bank opened custody to paying clients and signed an exploratory asset-management pact, extending bank-led crypto services while keeping the offer institutional.

item.title: Moody’s and Chainlink test multi-chain ratings delivery
item.description: Moody’s and Chainlink tested sending credit insights across multiple blockchains, extending beyond a single network but stopping short of live onchain ratings.

item.title: Treasury orders U.S. financial cutoff for MEXC over alleged $16B flows
item.description: FinCEN ordered U.S. firms to block transfers involving MEXC over alleged $16 billion in illicit flows, putting its U.S. financial access at stake once effective.

item.title: Zcash Activates NU7 as Post-Quantum Work Begins
item.description: Zcash’s NU7 upgrade cut target blocks to 25 seconds and redirected most transaction fees to a reserve, while a separate team began designing post-quantum cryptography.

item.title: Zcash activates NU7, cutting target block time to 25 seconds
item.description: Zcash activated NU7 at block 3,543,405, tripling its target block pace while changing shielded capacity, fee handling and support for legacy Sprout funds.

item.title: Binance’s $6.34bn heist began with a fake job interview
item.description: Binance says a months-long staff compromise enabled its $6.34bn theft, eclipsing Bybit's $1.5bn loss; freezes and company funds limit user losses.

item.title: Chainalysis restores services after all-user credential exposure
item.description: Chainalysis says names, usernames, password hashes and live tokens for all users were exposed; its core tools are back online after a week of shutdowns.

item.title: Zcash NU7 cuts target block time to 25 seconds
item.description: Zcash activated NU7 at block 3,543,405, cutting target block times to 25 seconds while changing fee flows and ending spends from its oldest pool.

item.title: Bitcoin reclaims $80,000 after Binance hack and midterms
item.description: Bitcoin rose 3.5% to $80,500 on Wednesday after a post-hack slide, while traders weighed the Binance recovery, election outcome and broader market risks.

item.title: Monad bridge: Fund now, move later?
item.description: A bridge moves assets between chains in a transaction; holding funds on Monad first is a separate choice, with different costs, timing and risks to weigh.

item.title: Flashbots Protect changes the route, not the swap
item.description: A private Ethereum transaction route can reduce public mempool exposure on a swap, but it cannot guarantee price, inclusion or protection from every form of MEV.

item.title: South Korea Seeks Fourth Delay to Crypto Tax, Now Until 2029
item.description: Seoul will seek to move crypto taxation from 2027 to 2029, citing missing US transaction data and rule changes, while proposing three-year loss offsets.

item.title: Binance says fake job interview preceded $6.34 billion theft
item.description: Binance says a fake job interview helped attackers steal $6.34 billion over months, showing how compromised staff and internal tools exposed wallet systems.

item.title: Binance traces record $6.34B theft to staged employee compromise
item.description: Binance says a staged employee compromise enabled the $6.34 billion theft, now the largest reported crypto heist, while recovery and independent review remain incomplete.
